items.html: And afterward, the four Mochin themselves of the GAR enter him in four other years, which is what we do in the blessing of the Avot, as explained there. And see there, how there is also an Ibur in the matter of these Mochin of the GAR of Gadlut, in addition to the first Ibur that was made in the Shema, to draw the makifim of Yenika and the six ends of Gadlut.
